en.description:
WatchDash is a fast rhythm platformer made for Apple Watch.

Tap to jump through spike patterns, land on blocks, collect coins, and switch into ship mode through portals. Each level has different obstacles, timing, and routes to master.

Features:

Apple Watch-first gameplay
Multiple levels
Cube jumping and ship flying
Coins hidden in harder paths
Unlockable cube skins
Completion progress for each level
Quick restarts for fast practice
Simple controls, short sessions, and challenging timing make WatchDash easy to start and satisfying to improve at.
en.releaseNotes:
Jumping has been rebuilt from the ground up. The cube now leaps a fixed two blocks with tighter, more predictable timing, so a jump always goes exactly as far as you expect.

New things to jump on and over:
- Jump pads that launch you to double height
- Tall spikes and spike pairs
- Floating platform routes you can hop up or drop down
- Saws set into the ground, with rounded hitboxes that read the way they look

Ship mode is much calmer. Gravity is gentler and every tap lifts you noticeably more, so tight corridors no longer mean frantic tapping. Portals now sit in the middle of the screen, and coming out of a ship section always drops you onto clear, safe ground.

The flashing beat indicator is gone, leaving the level itself to carry the rhythm.

Every level has been verified beatable start to finish, including on first sight with realistic reaction time.
en.subtitle: Rhythm Platformer
